decisions.summary: Synthetic prerequisite review at 11:30 UTC confirmed the site and approval-rule corrections before starting this separate 12:00 UTC invocation; the earlier BLOCKED report remains unchanged.

Synthetic exact user request at 12:00 UTC authorizes one draft requisition with DEMO-BU, DEMO-ITEM, DEMO-SUP, DEMO-SITE and quantity 1; retain evidence and do not submit it. This is not real authorization.
After inspecting the 12:05 UTC pre-deletion evidence, a separate synthetic user authorization at 12:07 UTC requests deletion of only DEMO-REQ-001. No deletion is implied by the original test request.
Synthetic cleanup record documents deletion of DEMO-REQ-001 at 12:08 UTC and manual absence verification at 12:09 UTC; the evidence captured before deletion is retained for this sample.

limitations: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE ONLY: every identity, task, timestamp, observation, approval and cleanup record is invented for demonstration; no Fusion system was accessed and no transaction was actually created or deleted.
This is a manual scenario illustration, not validated Oracle feature, screen, privilege, deletion-behavior or API documentation. A real pillar check must establish those contracts before execution.

The separate 10:00 UTC implementation-review sample remains BLOCKED. This later invocation explicitly records correction and prerequisite-review evidence at 11:30 UTC; it does not bypass the earlier blockers or rewrite that report.

READY_WITHIN_VERIFIED_SCOPE applies only to the single demonstrated draft-saving check. The approval-rule prerequisite was reviewed but no approval workflow was executed; end-to-end purchasing, downstream accounting and performance are outside scope.
Passing schema and assessment checks validate the internal consistency of this sample, not the truth of its invented evidence.
Pre-deletion evidence is a fictional capture note in the sample evidence catalog; no screenshot file is claimed to exist.
